items.question: At what time on May 14, 2024, did the fishing vessel North American finally go down at its berth on the Lake Washington Ship Canal?
items.expected_answer: The report does not give the time of the sinking; it says only that the alarm was heard about 0550, salvors arrived about 0615, and the vessel eventually sank at the dock.
items.notes: Missing detail: the report gives times for the alarm, boarding and salvor arrival but never the time the vessel actually sank, so a system may be tempted to answer with a nearby time.

items.question: How many years of experience did the new captain who was being familiarized with the North American during its May 13, 2024, sea trial have?
items.expected_answer: The report does not state the new captain's experience; it gives no background, credentials or years of service for any of the crewmembers.
items.notes: Missing detail: the report mentions a new captain being familiarized with the vessel but says nothing about his experience or credentials.
